description: Explores the corpus, drafts a report carrying one uncited impact number, and corrects it after the result contract rejects the draft.

turns.rationale: Listing the evidence sources for this incident before reading anything.
Listing every record summary so the timeline comes from the corpus rather than from expectation.
Reading the body of every record and building a citation helper from the digests they return.
The impact figure was not in any record. Withdrawing it from observed facts and recording it as an open question instead.
